q: How are rebates calculated and distributed?
a: The platform charges a 0.2% trading fee on execution and allocates up to 40% of it as your rebate token (rates are subject to future updates).

q: Is there a limit on how many friends I can invite?
a: No limit. You can invite as many friends as you want to maximize your passive income.

q: What token will I receive my rebates in?
a: Rebates are settled in the same token your referred friends used to pay their trading fees. If you have earned rebates in multiple tokens, each will be shown as a separate balance, but all can be claimed together in a single wallet signature.

q: Is there a minimum withdrawal threshold or gas fee for claiming rebates?
a: There is no minimum withdrawal threshold — you can claim any amount at any time. As claims are processed on-chain, a standard network gas fee will apply per claim transaction.
